fileUrlSubtitle.message: Allow the extension to read chess positions from local files

fileUrlExplain.message: To analyze chess diagrams from local PDF files or screenshots, ChessInsights needs permission to access file:// URLs. We'll guide you to the Chrome extensions settings to enable this.

howToEnable.message: How to Enable File URL Access

step1Permission.message: Click the 'Open Extension Settings' button below

step2Permission.message: In the Extensions page, find ChessInsights and toggle 'Allow access to file URLs'

step3Permission.message: Return to this page and click 'Next' to continue

permissionNote.message: Your files remain private - the extension only analyzes chess positions and never uploads your data
